# `security-scope-removed`

Required scope removed

| | |
|---|---|
| **Kind** | `wire` |
| **Default severity** | `info` |
| **Rule IDs** | `security-scope-removed` |
| **Status** | Implemented (M3) |
| **Group** | Security ([RULES.md section 3](../../RULES.md)) |

## What it detects

A requirement needs fewer scopes.

## Why this default

Tokens with the old scopes still work.

## Example

From test case [`security-scope-removed`](../../test/cases/security-scope-removed/): A required scope was removed.

`openapi.yaml`, base → revision:

```diff
  …
        - oauth:
          - read
-         - write
        responses:
          '200':
```

Findings:

- `security-scope-removed` · info · GET /pets

## Policy options

Every rule takes `severity` (`error`, `warn`, `info` or `off`), `fix` and `explanation` in the policy file. The policy file arrives in M6; see [POLICY.md](../../POLICY.md).

```yaml
rules:
  security-scope-removed: info
```
